domain_entities.name: LeaveRequest
domain_entities.purpose: Represents an employee's request for leave. Tracks the full lifecycle from draft through submission, approval/rejection, and potential cancellation. Carries the dates, type of leave, and all approval/rejection/cancellation audit trail fields.
lifecycle_states: DRAFT — initial state; employee is composing the request; not yet visible to manager
SUBMITTED — employee has submitted for manager review; awaiting action
APPROVED — manager has approved; leave balance has been deducted; terminal state (except cancellation)
REJECTED — manager has rejected; leave balance unchanged; terminal state
CANCELLED — request was withdrawn by employee (from DRAFT, SUBMITTED, or APPROVED); balance restored if previously approved; terminal state

domain_entities.name: LeaveBalance
domain_entities.purpose: Tracks an employee's leave entitlement, usage, and remaining balance for a specific leave type within a fiscal year. Deducted upon approval; restored upon cancellation of an approved request. pendingDays tracks submitted-but-not-yet-decided requests to prevent over-requesting.
lifecycle_states: ACTIVE — balance is in effect for the current fiscal year; leave can be requested against it
EXHAUSTED — remainingDays has reached zero; no further leave of this type can be taken this fiscal year
FROZEN — balance is temporarily locked (e.g., during payroll reconciliation); no deductions or accruals permitted
CLOSED — fiscal year ended; balance is archived and a new balance for the next fiscal year is created

domain_entities.name: LeavePolicy
domain_entities.purpose: Defines the rules and parameters for a specific leave type. Governs entitlement, accrual, notice periods, approval requirements, and balance constraints. Referenced by LeaveBalance and LeaveRequest to enforce business rules.
lifecycle_states: ACTIVE — policy is in effect; employees can request leave under this policy
INACTIVE — policy has been disabled; no new requests accepted; existing approved leave unaffected

domain_entities.name: Employee
domain_entities.purpose: Represents an employee in the organization. The managerId establishes the approval hierarchy for leave requests. Employment status gates eligibility for leave requests.
lifecycle_states: ACTIVE — employee is currently employed and eligible for leave
INACTIVE — employee is on extended leave or suspended; leave requests blocked
TERMINATED — employment ended; all balances closed; no further leave permitted

domain_entities.name: LeaveType
attributes: ANNUAL — planned vacation/personal leave; requires manager approval; deducted from annual entitlement
SICK — unplanned medical leave; may require documentation; deducted from sick entitlement
EMERGENCY — urgent unforeseen leave; requires manager approval; deducted from emergency entitlement or annual pool per policy
domain_entities.purpose: Enumeration of leave categories. Each type maps to a LeavePolicy and a corresponding LeaveBalance. The feature scope covers ANNUAL, SICK, and EMERGENCY.

domain_entities.name: LeaveType
domain_entities.purpose: Enumeration of leave categories within feature scope. Each type maps to a LeavePolicy and a corresponding LeaveBalance. ANNUAL: planned vacation/personal leave. SICK: unplanned medical leave. EMERGENCY: urgent unforeseen leave.

domain_entities.name: LeaveRequestStatus
domain_entities.purpose: Enumeration of states a LeaveRequest moves through during its lifecycle. See LeaveRequest.lifecycle_states for transition rules.

domain_entities.name: BalanceStatus
domain_entities.purpose: Enumeration of states a LeaveBalance moves through. See LeaveBalance.lifecycle_states for transition rules.

business_rules: BR-001 — Employee eligibility: Only employees with employmentStatus = 'ACTIVE' may submit a leave request. INACTIVE and TERMINATED employees are blocked from creating or submitting requests.

BR-002 — Manager approval chain: A leave request with status SUBMITTED must be approved or rejected by the employee's manager (Employee.managerId). The approving actor's ID is recorded in LeaveRequest.approvedBy. Self-approval is prohibited — an employee cannot approve their own request even if managerId is null.

BR-003 — Balance sufficiency check: On submission (DRAFT → SUBMITTED), the system must verify that the employee has a LeaveBalance for the requested leave type with remainingDays >= requested days. If remainingDays < requested days and the policy's allowNegativeBalance is false, the submission is rejected with an "insufficient balance" error. pendingDays is incremented by the requested day count upon submission.

BR-005 — Balance restoration on rejection: When a LeaveRequest transitions from SUBMITTED → REJECTED, the corresponding LeaveBalance.pendingDays is decremented by the requested day count. usedDays and remainingDays are unchanged.

BR-004 — Balance deduction on approval: When a LeaveRequest transitions from SUBMITTED → APPROVED, the corresponding LeaveBalance is updated: pendingDays is decremented by the requested day count, usedDays is incremented by the requested day count, and remainingDays is recalculated as totalEntitlement - usedDays. If remainingDays reaches 0, the balance status transitions to EXHAUSTED.

BR-006 — Balance restoration on cancellation: When a LeaveRequest transitions from APPROVED → CANCELLED, the LeaveBalance is restored: usedDays is decremented by the requested day count, remainingDays is recalculated. If the balance was EXHAUSTED, it returns to ACTIVE. When cancelled from SUBMITTED, only pendingDays is decremented (same as rejection). When cancelled from DRAFT, no balance impact.

BR-007 — Date validation: startDate must be before or equal to endDate. startDate must not be in the past at the time of submission (DRAFT → SUBMITTED). The requested date range must not overlap with any existing APPROVED or SUBMITTED LeaveRequest for the same employee.
